RebelAttribution.ChannelsClickHelp: Click a channel to see its campaigns, search engines, websites or social networks.
RebelAttribution.ChannelsHelp: Matomo gives a conversion to the last visit before it. Here every visit a visitor made in the %s days before converting can count. Pick a model to see what each channel gets with it, next to what it gets today.
RebelAttribution.DaysToConversion: Days from the first visit to the conversion
RebelAttribution.JourneysHelp: The channels visitors came by in the %s days before they converted, the oldest visit first. The most common journeys are shown.
RebelAttribution.LegendAssisted: Assisted: a visit in the middle
RebelAttribution.LegendClosed: Closed: the last visit of several
RebelAttribution.LegendIntroduced: Introduced: the first visit of several
RebelAttribution.LegendLast: The last visit gets it all (today)
RebelAttribution.ModelDecayHelp: A visit counts half as much for every 7 days it came before the conversion.
RebelAttribution.ModelFirstHelp: The first visit of the journey gets the whole conversion.
RebelAttribution.ModelLastNotDirectHelp: The last visit that came from somewhere gets the whole conversion. A direct entry only counts when there was nothing else.
RebelAttribution.ModelLinearHelp: Every visit of the journey gets the same share of the conversion.
RebelAttribution.ModelPositionHelp: The first and the last visit get 40% each and the visits between them share 20%.
RebelAttribution.NoGoals: This website has no goals yet. Add a goal to see which channels it is converted by.
RebelAttribution.NotCreditedToday: Gets no conversions when the last visit gets it all
RebelAttribution.RolesHelp: For the conversions a channel took part in: was it the first visit of the journey, one in the middle, the last, or the only one?
RebelAttribution.ShowNames: Show or hide what is in this channel
RebelAttribution.UnknownModel: Unknown attribution model. Use one of: %s.
